Sessions

Source: R/speeches.R
parl_sessions.Rd

One row per session, with its date, number of speeches and words, and the person who opened the chair.

Usage

parl_sessions()

Value

A tibble.

Examples

parl_sessions()
#> # A tibble: 259 × 6
#>    sessio                  data         any n_intervencions paraules presidencia
#>    <chr>                   <date>     <int>           <int>    <dbl> <chr>
